description: 대전광역시_도로시설물(지하차도 터널 육교 교량 등) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시. 대전광역시 도로시설물(지하차도 터널 육교 교량 등)자료는 대전광역시 건설관리본부 시설부 시설관리과에서 관리하는 1종 도로시설물의 현황 자료입니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
